resources.string: U thetshelesa u tsikeledzwa ha buthano ḽo khetheaho ḽa hardware na u zwi vhea kha iṅwe khoudu ya khii
App yo vhewaho kha buthano iḽi (%1$s) a yo ngo dzheniswa
Log press ya key inwe na inwe (ya u tandulula thaidzo fhedzi)
Log remapped buthano ḽa u tsitsa (u itela u tandulula thaidzo fhedzi)
%1$s thoma/u ima thokheni ya auth ya ndivho (nambatedzani mutevhe wo fhelelaho wa ‘auth: XXXX’ u bva kha tshikirini tsha %1$s tsha Vhonani ndivho)
Ṋeani thendelo ya %1$s, nga murahu ni tendele tshumelo iyi fhasi ha Swikelelo
Brand ya TV (i kwama %1$s TV button nga ho khetheaho)
